# Border

#### Course: Learn CSS

## Border

The border is the boundary line that surrounds the content of an element.

You can style it using the border property:

```html
1<h1>Sneakers on Sale</h1>
2<p>Step up your game with these trendy, ultra-comfortable sneakers designed for both performance and style. Perfect for casual wear or a workout!</p>
3<a href="#">Buy Now</a>
```

```css
1a {
2    background-color: #6603fc;
3    color: #ffffff;
4    text-decoration: none;
5
6    /* Border styling */
7    border: 4px solid #ff0000;
8}
```

Browser Output

![Simple Border](data:image/png;base64,)

Now, our button has a 4px thick, solid border of the color #ff0000 on all four sides.

![Idea Emoji](data:image/png;base64,)

Let's learn how to change the width, style, and color of a border.
